text:
I still think the answer is C, even though the team note limits the choices to A or B. The custom shutters were screwed and bracketed into the window frames, so under the annexation, adaptation and intent test they were fixtures that passed with the home. A fails because fixtures pass without being mentioned in the sales agreement. B fails because repainting the frames doesn't change what was conveyed, and the buyer can still recover the shutters' value or the cost of reinstallation.

CONFIDENCE: 80
